messages.content: This session is being continued from an earlier conversation that ran out of context. Summary: we are drafting a 4-week onboarding plan for new engineers. Week 1: setup and security basics. Week 2: codebase tour and a first small ticket. Week 3: customer shadowing (3 days) and an on-call shadow. Week 4: first feature and review. Continue from here.
Understood. I'll continue refining the plan.
Add a buddy system.
Done: each new engineer gets a buddy for all 4 weeks, with a 30-minute check-in on Fridays.
Put the dates in for a cohort starting Monday October 5.
Week 1: Oct 5–9. Week 2: Oct 12–16. Week 3: Oct 19–23. Week 4: Oct 26–30.
Which days in week 3 should be customer shadowing?
Tuesday to Thursday, Oct 20–22, so Monday is for planning and Friday for the on-call shadow handover and the retro.
Add learning goals to week 2.
Done: by Friday of week 2 the engineer can build and run the app, explain the request flow, and have a small ticket in review.
How do we measure whether onboarding worked?
Two measures: time to first merged PR (target: within 14 days) and a 4-week survey (target: at least 4 of 5 on 'I know who to ask').
Add that to the plan as a section.
Done: added a 'Success measures' section with those two measures and targets.
Should the buddy be on the same team?
Preferably yes, for context, but not their manager. A buddy on the same team can answer day-to-day questions.
Can you keep the plan within one page?
Yes, the current plan fits on one page.
Good. Give me a one-line title for the wiki.
'4-week engineering onboarding: setup, codebase, customers, first feature'.

HR says two things: (1) the company offsite is Oct 20–22, so the customer shadowing days in week 3 clash, and (2) the legal training must happen in week 1. I haven't changed the plan yet. Where does the plan stand?

required_facts: The customer shadowing days (Oct 20–22, week 3) clash with the offsite on the same dates and must be rescheduled
The legal training must be added to week 1 and is not in the plan yet
Nothing has been changed yet; where to move the shadowing has not been decided
critical_omissions: Saying the plan has already been updated
Choosing new shadowing dates as if they were agreed
Saying the conflict affects dates other than Oct 20–22
unnecessary_repetition: The buddy system and the success measures
The one-page note and the wiki title
